note: Panel recipe for tools/panelize.py. Tabs are given as a point near the board edge (single-board coordinates, mm, KiCad front view) and the outward direction; the tool finds the exact edge. All copper on this board stops 0.55 mm short of the edge. No tab sits on the switch (bottom edge, x 54 to 66), above the badge-supply track that runs 0.95 mm inside the top edge (x 42 to 62), or beside the cell clip's solder tabs (x 20 to 26, top and bottom).

tabs.why: middle of the flat left end (the cell slides in here once the board is broken out)
middle of the flat right end, beside the credit
top edge, between the cell clip and the connector's supply track
top edge, right of the supply track's bend, above the maker's white box
bottom edge, between the cell clip and the switch
